notes.attribute-ownership: Time result is inconclusive: paired ranges cross no change. Ownership transfer removes copies with no public data change.
notes.batch-album-attributes: Conditional. The largest album improves; the one-track case regresses. Do not batch every album without a size rule.
notes.gate_inline: Defer. Generated repeated-suspension state shows a small effect; this does not establish a useful app-level gain. Timing includes allocator counter updates.
notes.indexed-weights: Defer. Preparation is included once per matrix. No material benefit is established on this sample.
notes.job_projection: Reject this version. Overflowing JSON numbers change the error fallback for queued and waiting jobs. Valid-input timing does not override this failure.
notes.library_indices: Defer. No timing gain is established. Initial snapshot construction is excluded.
notes.library_summaries: Conditional. Repeated view operations improve, but preparing summaries for one view is slower and allocates more.
notes.read_serial_array: Useful small change. The event sequence is generated; the kernel ratio is not an app responsiveness claim.
notes.soulseek_prepared_query_one_pass: Small measured effect, below the 20% timing target. Real peer traffic was not sampled.
notes.source-index-array: Conditional. The 120-track case improves, but one-track cases regress. MBID output is checked; tag file writes are not measured.
notes.stack-track-score: Defer. Allocation traffic decreases, but time ranges overlap. String processing remains in both paths.
notes.summary_count_array: Useful small change. Counts use generated summary states over real descriptions. Output strings remain equal.
notes.upgrade_index_winner: Defer for speed. Allocation traffic decreases, but a timing improvement is not established. Download identity checks stay required.
notes.watch_queue_only: Prioritize with the shared-snapshot change. Eight generated queue updates are included. The initial table is built in both paths.
notes.watch_rows_indices: Prioritize. Output content and order match, and snapshot replacement rejects stale indices. The GPUI event loop is not measured.
notes.watchlist_fixed_actions_summary: Memory candidate. Requested Rust allocation bytes decrease; this is not a peak-memory measurement. Action JSON shape and sparse input behavior are checked.
